replaces: mobile_layout_spec.json (round 2). Same reference resolutions, updated for the new screens and the 5 UI themes.

global.stretch: canvas_items, aspect=expand. Phone: extra height goes to the board/list areas; anchor top bar to the top safe area and action bars to the bottom safe area.

touch.hover_replacement: long-press 350 ms on any card or relic opens the detail sheet (poster_paper of the active theme)
touch.drag: abilities can be dragged from the collection drawer, or tap ability then tap a row

themes.note: All mobile layouts are theme-agnostic: only the 9-slice folder, fonts and text colours change. Margins are the same in every kit, so StyleBoxes scale identically. On phone, draw 9-slice margins at 1.3-1.6x (texture_margin scale) so rims don't look thin.

backgrounds.note: Shaders adapt to any aspect; no separate mobile art needed. On low-end phones drop intensity to 0.5 or use the bg/*.jpg stills.

global.rider_theme_default: Gambler -> Classic, Machine -> Machine, Doctor -> Doctor (user can override in Settings).

table.phone: 5x5 board fills the middle; stats as 4 cells; payouts open as a bottom sheet from PAYS; kit row + Sleeve button above the action bar
table.tablet_l: desktop structure: HUD columns either side of the board
table.tablet_p: board on top, score + payouts panels side by side below

shop.phone: 3-column scrolling grid; tapping a slot fills the detail sheet; BUY in the action bar

abilities.phone: hand rows stack label above sockets; the collection is a bottom drawer that scrolls horizontally; RIDE ON pinned

ability_reward.all: 3 ability cards side by side (phone 330 px wide); focused card gets reveal rays + glow; TAKE / SKIP

campfire.phone: scene cropped to rider + fire in the top band, 3 choice cards in a row below, confirm button pinned
campfire.tablets: full scene with the 3 cards centred near the bottom

game_over.phone: title, epitaph, portrait + ledger side by side, relics row, trail strip as 3 rows (one region per row)

rider_select.phone: swipe carousel: focused card large, neighbours peek at the edges, page dots; signature selector below
rider_select.tablets: all three cards in a row; lore + signature icons panel on portrait

trail_map.phone: vertical winding path of 30 stops (21 tables + 3 outlaws + 3 shops + 3 campfires), scrolls; next-stop panel + RIDE ON pinned
